Game Overview

Christmas Memichan 2 is a adventure title where embark on a festive adventure with Santa Cat Memichan in this thrilling 2D platformer. Navigate Christmas landscapes, avoiding mischievous foes and perilous traps. Master precise controls and double jumps across eight increasingly challenging levels, collecting chocolate bars as you go. It's a cat-tastic holiday quest filled with surprises!
